description.zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识。
description.en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotency. This lets you safely retry the request without creating a duplicate diagnostic report. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
诊断类型，可选的有：

- Performance：性能诊断
description.en:
The diagnosis type. The only valid value is:

- Performance: performance diagnosis

description.zh: 结束时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The end time for the diagnosis, in UTC. The time must be in the ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ).

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ebs-2021-07-30-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i7)查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. Call the [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/developer-reference/api-ebs-2021-07-30-describeregions?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i7) operation to find all regions supported by EBS Data Insight.

description.zh:
资源类型。当前可选的有：

- Disk
description.en:
The resource type. The only valid value is:

- Disk: a cloud disk

description.zh: 开始时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time for the diagnosis, in UTC. The time must be in the ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs create-diagnose-report --diagnose-type Performance --resource-id d-asb1s8000 --resource-type Disk --start-time 2024-09-01T02:26:00Z --end-time 2024-09-07T16:49:25Z --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs CreateDiagnoseReport --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2024-09-07T16:49:25Z' --ResourceId 'd-asb1s8000' --StartTime '2024-09-01T02:26:00Z' --ResourceType Disk --DiagnoseType Performance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
